en-US.description: Agent orchestration tool of the openJiuwen platform with assistant, coding, and swarm modes.
en-US.longDescription: WorkSwarm is the agent orchestration tool of the openJiuwen agent platform. It offers personal-assistant, coding, and swarm modes, connects to channels such as Xiaoyi, Feishu, DingTalk, and Telegram, coordinates multiple agents through Agent Swarm with shared skills, and keeps evolving from execution traces and feedback signals. The product is a workflow-orchestration tool only and contains no AI model capability.

zh-CN.longDescription: WorkSwarm 是 openJiuwen 智能体平台的智能体编排工具，提供个人助手、编码与集群三种模式，可连接小艺、飞书、钉钉、Telegram 等渠道，通过 Agent Swarm 实现多智能体协同与技能共享，并基于执行轨迹与反馈信号持续进化。本产品仅作为流程编排工具，不包含 AI 模型能力。
